g.text: WORKED EXERCISE · SELECT THE 9–16 DAY BAND

Theorem grade_lowered_once : forall (late_days : nat) (g : grade), (late_days <? 9 = false) -> (late_days <? 17 = true) -> apply_late_policy late_days g = lower_grade g.Proof. intros late_days g H9 H17. rewrite apply_late_policy_unfold. rewrite H9. rewrite H17. reflexivity.Qed.
H9 selects the outer else branch.H17 selects the next then branch.The remaining goal is lower_grade g = lower_grade g.
Practice: formulate the boolean hypotheses for the two-step and three-step bands.
